findings.title: Recheck the live T6 lease after later lock waits
findings.body: The full T6 path uses a lease observation from before later blocking locks. ProtocolExecutionService._commit calls require_current_fence at protocol_execution.py:319, then obtains S38; idempotent_outcome obtains receipt and S29/S37 at transactions.py:5571 before calling the new _prepare_full_execution. The latter only loads snapshot_id and fresh clock_timestamp here and verifies source closure; it never reruns require_current_fence/require_live. _require_fence_guard at 5697 verifies the cached LIVE marker, not the present lease time. prepare_authorization_basis includes the request deadline in its validity minimum but omits lease_expires_at, and the subsequent inserts, updates, validate_completion and finish do not close this gap. A worker can therefore pass the initial lease check, wait on S29 until its lease expires, and still commit a complete bundle and FOUND_VALID_PLAN/COMMITTED when all source, policy and deadline bounds remain live. This violates the packet's current lease guard and frozen Protocol 5.3/6.5 and DB 4.3/T6 boundaries.
findings.required_change: Under the already held frozen-order locks, rerun the exact current owner/fence/request/attempt/status/lease/deadline guard with trusted post-lock database time before full T6 prepares or mutates its outcome. Add an own-namespace real PostgreSQL test that leaves source/policy/manifest/deadline validity live, observes the T6 waiter blocked on S29 or S37, lets only its actual finite lease expire, releases the blocker, and asserts the lease denial plus exact zero effects including first-use head, members, issuances, closures, success, receipt/event/outbox. Rerun affected packet checks and persist a new result and fresh reviews.
findings.verification_limit: This is an independently traced code interleaving, not a newly executed DB reproducer. The authorized review prohibited DB lifecycle. The committed T6 post-lock witness uses admission_seconds=8 and reports lease_seconds=600, so its expired resolution denial proves a different time boundary and cannot establish the missing lease oracle. Existing lease denial sets an already expired lease before ingress, which also cannot catch expiry during the later wait.

Server validity includes both resolutions, validation, exact admitted freshness, projections, manifest, artifacts, TTL/calendar/deadline with caller shortening only. Observed race and injected failure assertions preserve immutable history and rollback. These checks do not cure KL077-DB-001.
verification.locks_and_pause: T6 retains S51/S01/S27/S38/receipt/S29/S37 order, and current typed T7 retains S51/S01/head/session/receipt. The separate ordinary pause descriptor has only S01/S44/S02/S03/S04; exact capability checks bind authenticated TEST identity/key, APP_STARTED current immutable START-or-RESUME identity/hash, lifecycle/revision and reason. It reads no current registry/A/head eligibility, writes no S45/issuance/actual/control/epoch, and cannot generically patch a session. Raw pause witnesses show lock stages [20,70,80], unchanged original binding/history, historical replay after resume, rollback, successful pause after authority loss/head change and successful pause with S51 blocked. Protective controls remain the distinct existing T2 path.
verification.raw_check_integrity: Independently recomputed all fourteen raw final log SHA256 values and verified exact tested SHA/command headers, successful exit summaries, nonzero executed counts and no skipped/xfail substitution. Named checks report PU 1 each; commit DC 1; denials DC 28; pause DC 19; current T7 DC 9; atomicity DC 8; full own DC 81; unit 230; harness 676. Harness/lint/typecheck raw success records match. Passing process statuses alone do not establish all packet oracles; the lease wait gap blocks task approval.
verification.raw_race_oracles: Parsed committed full-suite raw witnesses directly: 81 namespaces/cleanup inventories, 69 exact-cause zero-effect denials, two observed duplicate races blocked on S01, four actual T7 positives before authority loss, nine lifecycle/current-binding preconditions, three current T7 positive outcomes, seven pause witnesses, F2 repair and two finite-minimum validity witnesses. Four expiry waits observed actual PostgreSQL blockers on S29, S38 or S44, with trusted times before/after finite admission expiry and exact resolution/TIME_INELIGIBLE denials. Exact half-open equality stays PU; those DC witnesses do not cover lease-only expiry after the later lock.
